vocabulary.word: ありがとうございました
vocabulary.reading: ありがとうございました
vocabulary.meaning: thank you very much (past tense, polite)

grammar: Standard polite closing phrase used at the end of Japanese television broadcasts. ご is an honorific prefix elevating 視聴 (viewing). ありがとうございました (past tense) acknowledges the completed act of watching. This is a formal broadcast register, unrelated to the story.
